blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateActorRolePermissionsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

Validates that the actor can grant every role being assigned or unassigned,
as decided by `canActorGrantRoles`: an actor can only assign roles whose
policies they themselves have, within the scope the assignment targets.

children.name: granting_scope
children.description:
The scope the actor is acting within. If set, only the actor's role
assignments scoped to it count towards assignments targeting that same
scope.

children.name: assignments
children.description:
The role <> scope pairs being granted. A pair without a scope applies
across all scopes, so it requires the actor's unscoped privileges.

children.name: scope
children.description:
A scope a request acts within, identified by the scope
entity's type and id (e.g. 

`{ type: "organization", id: "org_123" }`

).
